scope: Sixteen IMA September 2026 critical-element mineral species (bario-orthojoaquinite, behoite, calciohilairite, cassidyite, coconinoite, dissakisite-(Ce), franciscanite, lucasite-(Ce), manganokhomyakovite, metazellerite, olmsteadite, petscheckite, titanowodginite, virgilite, widgiemoolthalite, zektzerite) with 100% primary-source visual inspection across all IMA-cited references and four bounded laboratory thermal/topotactic mechanisms. Five carried-forward candidates remain explicitly deferred.

deduplication.note: No pre-existing owner record in data/records/ matched any of the 16 selected mineral species prior to Round 120 creation (manganokhomyakovite and petscheckite appeared only as deferred candidates in Round 119 research/ingest notes).

primary_sources.role: Official IMA-CNMNC September 2026 List of Mineral Names
primary_sources.inspection: All 244 pages visually inspected (including extracted rows on pp. 20, 23, 35, 38, 48, 58, 77, 128, 135, 143, 159, 170, 218, 229, 234, 240); verifies status, formula, approval tag, and primary references for all 16 mineral species.
All 8 pages visually inspected, including Benitoite Gem Mine type material, Table 1 column 5 electron and ion microprobe analysis, and orthorhombic Ccmm/Cc2m/Ccm21 crystallography.
